cd /opt/ai-relay && sudo mkdir -p /opt/ai-relay/static/brand && echo '' | sudo tee /tmp/keyo-docs.b64 >/dev/null && base64 -d /tmp/keyo-docs.b64 | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-docs.html >/dev/null && echo '' | sudo tee /tmp/keyo-ref.b64 >/dev/null && base64 -d /tmp/keyo-ref.b64 | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-api-ref.md >/dev/null && echo '' | sudo tee /tmp/keyo-ref-en.b64 >/dev/null && base64 -d /tmp/keyo-ref-en.b64 | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-api-ref.en.md >/dev/null && sudo bash /opt/ai-relay/scripts/deploy-brand-static.sh || true && curl -sS -o /tmp/docs.html https://www.keyoapi.xyz/brand/keyo-docs.html && curl -sS -o /tmp/ref.md https://www.keyoapi.xyz/brand/keyo-api-ref.md && python3 - <<'PY'
